features.name: Import footage
features.purpose: Get raw footage into a project. Dropping footage is the whole instruction.
inputs: project name derived from the filename
features.transport: RAW BODY (application/octet-stream) with x-snipai-project and x-snipai-filename headers, streamed to disk via node:stream/promises pipeline. XHR on the client for upload progress. A multipart path is still accepted for compatibility.
errorStates: not a video (400)
project already exists (409)
arrives empty (400)
disk write failure (500, project dir removed)
knownWeaknesses: NO SIZE CAP on the project importer (the reference uploader caps at 600MB) — LEDGER S3 partially addressed by streaming, the cap is still absent
dedupe is by filename or exact byte size; two different takes of identical size collide
a second drop REPLACES the queue rather than appending

features.name: Automatic pipeline (transcribe → draft → proxy → build)
features.purpose: Turn raw footage into a cut with no second step.
outputs: work/transcript.json, silence.txt, silence-strict.txt, beat-analysis.json, source-proxy.mp4, edl.json, extract.sh, concat.txt
features.concurrency: ONE heavy job at a time, enforced by runningJob(); a second request returns 409.
errorStates: python3/ffmpeg unavailable (503)
faster-whisper missing (503)
raw footage not on this machine (404)
a step fails (job status error, message in the log)
a step goes quiet for 5 minutes (killed, now warned about first)
knownWeaknesses: the auto build renders from the 720p PROXY and the UI does not say so
unbounded stdout accumulation over a 6-hour cap — LEDGER S4
job.log re-serialised every 2s — LEDGER S4
six routes spawn ffmpeg/Whisper without the runningJob guard — LEDGER S15

features.name: beats.json — the edit itself
features.purpose: THE artifact. Everything else is raw footage or rebuildable. One entry per line: label, start, end, text, optional holes/fades/detached audio.
features.persistence: atomic write (tmp + rename) via lib/jsonStore.writeJsonAtomic; a snapshot of the PREVIOUS state is taken before every write
errorStates: unreadable/corrupt → readBeats returns {ok:false,missing:false,why} and the project shows on the queue with a problem instead of vanishing
invariants: saveBeats returns whether it wrote; a no-op write is skipped and reported as such
every write burns exactly one snapshot; a no-op burns none

features.name: Highlight a region and delete it (snippet editor)
features.purpose: Take a stretch out of the middle of a line; the picture either side butts together.
entryPoints: drag across the waveform, then Delete/Backspace or the 'Cut this bit out' button
errorStates: a hole that is the whole line (400)
leaves under 0.15s (400)
lands inside an existing hole → changed:false, 'that stretch is already cut out', highlight KEPT
knownWeaknesses: a partial-overlap cut reports the whole highlight length in the toast, not what was removed

features.name: Ripple delete across the timeline
features.purpose: One drag across the cut removes that stretch, however many lines it crosses.
outputs: holes and/or dropped beats, applied atomically
errorStates: would delete the whole video (400)
one line's holes refused → the WHOLE span is rejected (atomic)
resolves to no change → changed:false

features.name: Undo (⌘Z)
features.purpose: Restore the beat list to the state before the last edit.
stateChanges: a snapshot of the pre-undo state
errorStates: nothing to undo
undo to the current state → changed:false, 'there was nothing to undo'
knownWeaknesses: THERE IS NO REDO. ⌘⇧Z is not bound anywhere. The client history is in-memory only and is lost on refresh.
the server-side undo path merges nothing from disk, deliberately (LEDGER S1 wontfix) — undo must be able to REMOVE a hole

features.name: Version history (snapshots)
features.purpose: A copy of beats.json aside before every write, with a reason, restorable.
features.naming: timestamp in the FILENAME, not the mtime; reason slugged with spaces→underscore so hyphens in labels survive
errorStates: restore snapshots first, so a restore is itself undoable

features.name: Build the cut
features.purpose:
beats.json → edl.json → extract.sh (one ffmpeg per clip) → concat -c copy → cuts/

-vN.mp4, then the two checks.
outputs: a cut file at SOURCE resolution
errorStates: build_cut.py failed
no extract.sh produced
extraction killed after clip N of M
ffmpeg concat failed
knownWeaknesses: the render exceeds the EDL by ~half a frame per piece (frame quantisation, measured and bounded, not a defect)

features.name: Trim a line's in/out points
features.purpose: The take is right, the edges are wrong.
inputs: drag a 1px handle, or [ and ] keys (0.05s, 0.20s with shift), or I/O at the playhead
errorStates: under 0.15s (400)
start after end (400)
negative (400)
already there → changed:false
knownWeaknesses: trim never re-runs normaliseHoles, so a hole can end up covering the whole beat — LEDGER S8

features.name: Split a beat (⌘B / S)
features.purpose: Cut one line into two at the playhead.
stateChanges: two beats replace one; holes partitioned, detached audio divided, fadeIn to the head and fadeOut to the tail
errorStates: split too close to an edge (each half must be ≥0.15s)
a cut needs at least one beat

features.name: Drag a line to a new place
errorStates: order must list every existing beat exactly once (400)
dropped where it already was → changed:false

features.name: Delete a line
stateChanges: review-state.deletedBeats records the label, text and range
errorStates: a cut needs at least one beat (400)

features.name: The timeline
features.purpose: Two tracks (video + audio), zoom, waveform at device-pixel resolution, filmstrip, 1px playhead, 1px trim handles, fade grips, range selection.
knownWeaknesses: no snap and no snap toggle — verified absent, selection is free-form to the millisecond

features.name: Playback and scrubbing
modes: 'Your cut' — live edit off the 720p proxy, beat to beat, skipping holes
interactions: click the timeline or waveform to scrub
invariants: the playhead is driven by requestAnimationFrame, not timeupdate (measured 47 updates/sec)
holes are skipped ONLY while playing — paused, the playhead stays where it was put
tests: NONE automated. Verified by driving the app manually.
knownWeaknesses: no automated playback test of any kind

features.name: Lines list / carousel
features.purpose: The script as cut. The playing line lights and scrolls into view; it yields for 4s if you scroll.
features.verified: line-level highlight tracks the playhead across all 34 beats and across cuts, in both player modes
knownWeaknesses: THE WORD-LEVEL HIGHLIGHT NEVER RENDERS — BUG-010, open. The code exists; `spoken` is null at runtime.

features.name: Take picker
features.purpose: The drafter's in/out is not the only take; open the window and see the others.
errorStates: candidate scan unavailable (422)
could not parse candidate scan output (500)
knownWeaknesses: CWD-relative project path where every other caller passes absolute — LEDGER S5
takePicks is empty, so nothing has taught it — DOCKET R3

features.name: Motion graphics and definition cards
kinds: ai_overlay (recorded as a request; generation is parked)
entryPoints: the folded panel under the timeline
voice input in the graphic dialog
knownWeaknesses: graphic ids collide every 16m40s (Date.now().slice(-6)) — deleting one deletes both — LEDGER S14

features.name: Scorecard and flags
knownWeaknesses: parsed out of tool STDOUT by regex; a wording change silently returns 'needs a built cut', which is indistinguishable from 'not built yet'. Pinned by tests/scorecard-coupling.test.mts.

features.name: Re-score without rebuilding
features.purpose: Re-run the two checks against the cut that already exists — seconds, not a 4K re-render.

features.name: Learning from edits
guards: a `learned_through` watermark so the same edits are not counted twice
features.history: This loop ran away once: reading the wrong tuning.json compounded shifts 11x to snap_tail 1.359 and left 10.8s of dead air.
knownWeaknesses: a no-op trim used to record a zero-delta entry, dragging the tuner toward zero — fixed

features.name: Delete a project / Recently deleted
features.retention: RETAIN_DAYS = 5, the delete time read out of the folder name

features.name: Settings
sections: Products SnipAi listens for + Amazon affiliate tag
knownWeaknesses: Products & links writes a file only an uninvoked tool reads — DOCKET R2
references: measured.map indexes the input array by output position, crediting the wrong files — LEDGER S13

features.name: Connectors
features.status: ALL EIGHT are hard-coded not_connected. There is no OAuth, no token store, no posting code. This is a stub surface — DOCKET B1.

features.name: Media streaming
features.purpose: Serves raw footage, the proxy, and cuts with HTTP Range support so the video elements can seek.
features.security: resolveMediaPath resolves against PROJECTS_ROOT and rejects anything that escapes it
knownWeaknesses: 416 for a range past EOF instead of clamping to size-1 — LEDGER S18

features.name: Voice input
features.purpose: Describe a graphic by talking instead of typing.

features.name: Filmstrip
knownWeaknesses: cache key omits the cut file, so v2 shows v1's frames — LEDGER S11
count is never NaN-checked and NaN reaches argv and the cache key — LEDGER S12

features.name: Waveform peaks
knownWeaknesses: CWD-relative project path — LEDGER S5

features.name: Native macOS wrapper
features.purpose: Owns the server process, sets the SNIPAI_ environment contract, opens a WKWebView on 127.0.0.1:4737, always on the primary display.
knownWeaknesses: unsigned — Gatekeeper will stop it on any other Mac (DOCKET B2)
x86_64 only (DOCKET B4)
deliberately NO Undo item in the Edit menu: a menu key equivalent would swallow the page's ⌘Z
